title: AMS user, sign-in and activity log settings
source_system: AMS admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: One user account, the owner's administrator account; the vendor enforces an authenticator app code at every sign-in; the owner's phone is the only registered authenticator and no backup sign-in method is set up; roles are set by user; the activity log records sign-ins and record changes; the report history shows no activity report run or exported

title: AMS client upload portal and data export settings
source_system: AMS admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: The client upload portal is included in the subscription and turned off, with no client uploads on record; the export tool offers a full export of records and documents; the export history is empty

title: AMS book of business report, Q2 2026
source_system: AMS reporting (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About 640 client accounts (about 510 personal lines households and about 130 small businesses) and about 1,150 policies in force with the 9 appointing insurers and 2 markets reached through the wholesale broker; the lead insurer accounts for about 40% of the book; about 60 commercial policies are set to agency bill; customer records name about 1,900 individuals (current and former clients, listed drivers, business owners), about 60 of them with a primary mailing address outside Florida; a mailing address is on file for every client; lines written are personal and commercial property and casualty only, with no health or group health lines; records in the AMS begin in 2022

title: AMS AI assistant release notes, setting and AI terms
source_system: AMS release notes and admin settings (SYS-01); AMS vendor website
what_it_shows: The 2026-06 release added an AI assistant that drafts emails and summarizes activity notes, turned on by default; the setting is on; the vendor's AI terms say customer data is not used to train shared models and prompts are kept 30 days; the activity log shows a few assistant drafts of renewal emails

title: Email and file suite admin console: security, mailbox and retention settings
source_system: Email and file suite admin console (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Business plan with one user, the owner, who is also the tenant administrator; second step at sign-in is a text message code to the owner's phone, turned on in 2025; forwarding to outside addresses is allowed (the default setting); no alert policy for new mailbox rules; no forwarding or inbox rules are present; the 30-day sign-in history lists only the owner's laptop and phone; no record of a sign-in history review; deleted items and file versions are kept 30 days; no backup service is connected; spam and phishing filtering is on and external senders are tagged

title: Email and file suite business plan terms and data protection addendum
source_system: Email and file suite vendor website; admin console
what_it_shows: The business plan terms include the vendor's data protection addendum, which covers customer data in mail and file storage

title: Mailbox and file storage content review
source_system: Email and file suite (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: The mailbox and file storage hold applications, loss runs, payroll reports and bank draft forms sent and received as attachments, some with driver license and Social Security numbers; invoices for agency-billed policies are sent as attachments that carry the premium trust account's bank details; no message telling clients that bank details are never changed by email appears in sent items or the AMS templates; a 2025 insurer email reminds agents to turn on MFA

title: Fake invoice near miss: client email thread and registrar report
source_system: Email inbox (SYS-02); AMS activity notes (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: On 2026-07-08 a small-business client forwarded an email that looked like the agency's renewal invoice for an $18,400 workers compensation deposit premium, sent from a domain one letter different from the agency's, with new bank details; the activity note records that the client called the owner before paying; the owner's report of the lookalike domain to its registrar and the registrar's acknowledgment are in the inbox

title: Insurer portal, rater and partner portal security settings
source_system: Insurer agent portals, comparative rater, premium finance portal, wholesale broker portal (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: 7 of the 9 insurer portals require a second factor at sign-in; 2 insurer portals offer password sign-in only; the comparative rater offers MFA and it is turned off; the premium finance and wholesale broker portals are reached with the owner's own accounts

title: E-signature account settings
source_system: E-signature service (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Sender account in the owner's name; signing links go to the client's email address on file; signed applications and bank draft authorizations are stored in the account

title: Laptop settings review
source_system: Laptop settings screens (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption on; automatic operating system updates on with current update history; built-in antivirus on with real-time protection; host firewall on; screen lock after 5 minutes; the browser stores agency portal passwords and its password check flags some as reused; synced file folders and the downloads folder hold client documents

title: Mobile phone settings and content review
source_system: Mobile phone settings screens and messaging app (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Passcode set and device encryption on; screen lock after 30 seconds; automatic updates and built-in protection on; remote wipe not turned on; holds the authenticator app for the AMS and receives the email and bank text codes, and no other device is registered; text threads with clients include photos of driver licenses; the text thread with the bookkeeper includes bank one-time codes forwarded on request

title: Printer-scanner settings page and lease
source_system: Printer-scanner admin menu (SYS-06); signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: The leased multifunction printer-scanner keeps scanned images on internal storage that is not encrypted and scans to the agency mailbox; the lease ends and the device goes back to the dealer on 2026-11-30

title: Home office and garage walk-through
source_system: Home office and garage (observation)
what_it_shows: The agency room is used only for the agency, is locked when the owner is away, and receives visitors by appointment; a cross-cut shredder is in the room; current signed forms are scanned into the AMS and shredded; the retired laptop (replaced in 2025) is in a closet; boxes of client files from 2014 to 2021 sit on the garage floor, open to the household; office practices are not written down

title: Home router admin page and connected devices
source_system: Internet provider's router admin page (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: The admin page opens with the default password printed on the router label; one Wi-Fi network; connected devices include the laptop, phone and printer-scanner, family phones, a game console and a smart TV; the installed firmware is the version from setup and no update history is shown

title: Online banking user settings, operating and premium trust accounts
source_system: Bank online banking portal (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: One online banking user, the owner, with full rights on both accounts; sign-in takes a password and a text code to the owner's phone; the bank offers separate sub-users and none is set up

title: Premium trust account statements and monthly reconciliations, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Bank statements; accounting SaaS (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: A separate premium trust account; about $240,000 of premium deposited in the 12 months by check and bank transfer; net premium remitted to insurers; a reconciliation by the bookkeeper for each month; no card deposits

title: Accounting SaaS user list and records
source_system: Accounting SaaS admin settings (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: Two named users: the owner (administrator) and the bookkeeper, whose role is limited to bookkeeping and reports; records and imported bank statements go back 7 years; deposit records hold client names, premium amounts and client payment details

title: Operating account and card statements, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Business bank and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the AMS vendor, the email and file suite, the e-signature service, the comparative rater, the accounting SaaS, the phone carrier, the internet provider, the printer-scanner lease and the E&O insurer; monthly payments to the bookkeeper; hourly payments to the IT consultant; no payment to a backup service, password manager, or payment card processor

title: Signed agreements folder inventory
source_system: Signed agreements folder; email inbox
what_it_shows: AMS subscription contract with breach notice to the agency and full data export on request and for 60 days after termination; IT consultant services agreement with confidentiality and security terms signed 2026-07-27, and no earlier written terms; bookkeeper engagement letter with no confidentiality or security terms; click-through subscription terms for the e-signature service and the comparative rater, with no record of review; wholesale broker agreement; premium finance company producer agreement, security terms not read; printer-scanner lease; no agreement with breach counsel; no emergency servicing arrangement with another agent; no vendor list

title: Insurer agency agreements and data security addenda
source_system: Signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: 9 agency agreements; 4, including the lead insurer's, carry a data security addendum that requires safeguards consistent with GLBA section 501(b), a designated individual, MFA for access to insurer systems and to agency systems holding the insurer's policyholder information, notice to the insurer within 72 hours of discovering a security incident involving its policyholders' information, cooperation and no notice to its policyholders without coordinating, and an annual security questionnaire

title: Lead insurer's annual agency security questionnaire
source_system: Email inbox (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Received 2026-06-15; the response and a remediation plan are due 2026-09-30; it asks for a written information security program, a designated responsible individual, a risk assessment, MFA on systems holding policyholder information, and an incident response plan

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents
source_system: Laptop; file storage; email; paper files
what_it_shows: No written information security program or policy, risk assessment, incident response plan or contact list, designation of a responsible individual, vendor list, data location list, retention or disposal schedule, disposal record, change record, or security training record was found

title: License and continuing education records
source_system: Florida Department of Financial Services licensee search and continuing education transcript
what_it_shows: The owner holds a Florida resident general lines (property and casualty) agent license and no other state's license; the agency holds a Florida insurance agency license under its trade name; the owner is the only licensed person listed for the agency; the business address is the owner's Florida home office; continuing education for the current cycle covers insurance topics and no information security course

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files (prepared by the tax preparer)
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000 in commissions; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: E&O policy declarations and cyber and social engineering endorsement
source_system: E&O insurer policyholder portal
what_it_shows: E&O policy in force with a cyber and social engineering endorsement; sublimits of $50,000 for incident response costs and $25,000 for social engineering fraud loss; the endorsement requires notice to the insurer as soon as practicable and use of the insurer's panel vendors

title: AMS vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: AMS vendor (provided under a nondisclosure agreement)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, with an unqualified opinion and one access-removal exception; the system description states RTO 4 hours and RPO 1 hour; backups are encrypted, integrity-checked and stored in a separate region; MFA is enforced for customer users; lists complementary user entity controls; the hosting provider is a carved-out subservice organization

title: AI chatbot account settings and chat history
source_system: Consumer generative AI chatbot account (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Consumer plan in the owner's name with password sign-in; the setting that lets the vendor use chats to improve its models is on; the history starts 2026-04-06, with chats about twice a week comparing quotes and drafting coverage summaries and renewal emails from pasted declarations pages, applications and quote printouts for about 40 client accounts, including names, addresses, vehicle identification numbers and prior claims; a search of the history found driver license numbers for 7 clients and no Social Security numbers

title: AI chatbot consumer terms, as accepted
source_system: AI chatbot vendor website
what_it_shows: Click-through consumer terms that let the vendor use chats to improve its models unless the user opts out; no data protection or confidentiality terms for business data

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Owner-agent's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems, insurers and vendors used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; the owner is the only licensed person and the only person who can bind or change coverage; claims calls surge after hurricanes; renewals are worked 30 to 60 days ahead

title: Risk walk-through of devices, accounts and payment flow
source_system: Walk-through of the laptop, phone, router, SaaS accounts and invoicing with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: Where client information ends up day to day (AMS, mailbox attachments, synced folders, phone messages, printer-scanner storage, the retired laptop, garage boxes, chatbot history); the owner texts the bank code to the bookkeeper on request; the bookkeeper works from the bookkeeper's own computer, which the agency has never seen; clients who know the owner sometimes call before paying an invoice

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner-agent's written answers to the requirement questions, checked on screen with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: The owner did not know the Florida 30-day notice clock, the addenda's 72-hour insurer notice, or the E&O endorsement's notice steps; the 2026-07-08 near miss was handled by phone and not written up; security setting changes, such as turning on email text codes in 2025, are not recorded; the rater, e-signature service and AI chatbot were adopted without a security check; no security alert or update service is subscribed; the owner has not checked that the owner's own security knowledge is current

title: AI use review: chatbot history and sent coverage summaries
source_system: AI chatbot account (SYS-08); AMS activity notes and sent mail (SYS-01, SYS-02)
what_it_shows: The last chat is dated 2026-08-04 and none follows the pause on 2026-08-05; one coverage comparison sent to a client in July 2026 stated the wrong windstorm deductible, and the activity notes show a corrected comparison sent before the policy was bound; AI-drafted comparisons were not checked against the policy forms before sending

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register; P05 BIA; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment identifies 15 threat events with sources and vulnerabilities, rates likelihood and impact with Tables G-5 and I-2 against the BIA impact categories, includes harm to clients from disclosure and redirected premiums, is documented in the register and report, and was summarized for the lead insurer's questionnaire; no review frequency or update trigger was defined at the time of assessment

title: Control assessment: Banking identity test and bookkeeper interview
source_system: Bank user settings; bank sign-in history; bookkeeper interview by phone
what_it_shows: The bank lists one user, the owner; the bookkeeper's sign-ins, transfers and downloads are recorded under the owner's identity; the bookkeeper confirmed signing in with the owner's credentials and asking the owner for the texted code, and has had the credentials since 2023

title: Control assessment: MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Insurer portal, rater, email and bank security pages; sign-in tests from a new browser
what_it_shows: The comparative rater and 2 insurer portals signed in with a password only; email and online banking asked only for a text code; the AMS asked for the authenticator app code and the other 7 insurer portals asked for a second factor

title: Control assessment: Password and code handling test
source_system: Browser password store (count only); router admin page; account recovery settings; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The browser held 23 saved agency passwords, 6 of them reused; the router admin page still opened with the default password; the bank code is texted to the bookkeeper and the shared banking credential has not changed since 2023; no written rule covers a lost phone, a compromised password, or how to protect credentials; each vendor verified the owner's identity when the account was opened; the laptop and phone are encrypted and lock automatically

title: Control assessment: Mailbox and sign-in review test
source_system: Email sign-in history; mailbox rules and forwarding settings; AMS activity log; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No record shows a review of email sign-ins, mailbox rules, or the AMS activity log; forwarding to outside addresses is allowed; no process exists to act on review results or to review more often after the 2026-07-08 near miss or a vendor notice

title: Control assessment: Document exchange test
source_system: 30-day sample of sent and received email; phone messages; AMS upload portal settings
what_it_shows: Applications, loss runs and bank draft forms were sent and received as plain attachments in the 30-day sample; 9 client driver license photos were still in the phone's messages; the AMS upload portal is off

title: Control assessment: Vendor oversight review
source_system: Signed agreements folder; AMS SOC 2 report; bookkeeper engagement letter; AI chatbot terms; IT consultant agreement
what_it_shows: The bookkeeper and the AI chatbot vendor hold client data with no security terms, and the chatbot's consumer terms allow model training; no vendor checklist, standard terms, or vendor list; the AMS SOC 2 report lists customer responsibilities and the IT consultant's agreement (2026-07-27) defines the consultant's role; only the AMS vendor is monitored (SOC 2 review 2026-08-06)

title: Control assessment: Backup review
source_system: AMS SOC 2 report; email and file retention settings; AMS export settings
what_it_shows: The AMS vendor backs up the system and encrypts, integrity-checks and separately stores the backups (SOC 2 report, no exceptions); email and files have no backup beyond 30 days of deleted items and versions; no AMS export exists; security documents are kept only in the file suite with 30-day versions

title: Control assessment: Disposal test
source_system: Retired laptop boot test; printer-scanner stored-jobs menu and lease; phone hand-down record
what_it_shows: The retired laptop booted straight to the owner's old account with client files present; the printer-scanner's stored-jobs menu holds stored scans and its storage has never been cleared, with the lease return due 2026-11-30; the owner's previous phone was encrypted and factory reset before it was handed to a family member in 2025; no sanitization method or certificate standard is defined
